title: primula elatior subsp. lofthousei
intro: Primula elatior subsp. lofthousei, commonly known as the yellow form of the greater primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Primula elatior subsp. lofthousei include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
